name: xcode-companion
title: Xcode Companion
description: Control iOS Simulators and Xcode tools directly from Raycast
author: luca_deltort

commands.name: manage-ios-simulators
commands.title: Manage iOS Simulators
commands.subtitle: Xcode Companion
commands.description: List, boot, and control iOS Simulators (toggle dark mode, erase data)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
